title: Test-Plan Approval Gates
description: The single declaration of the test-plan approval gate set (#2710, epic #2693). Both the test plan template's Approval Checklist and the /create-prd approval issue's Review Checklist are rendered from `text`, in declared order.

gates.description: Approval gates in the order both surfaces render them. Order is data, not incidental: the rendered checklists are compared element-wise.

_meta.description: Human-facing notes. Not read by any consumer.

id.description: Stable identifier. Referenced by the rollup (#2711) and the confirmation phase (#2712), so it outlives any wording change to `text`.

text.description: The canonical rendered string. This is the checklist line itself, not a label for it — both surfaces must reproduce it verbatim.

criteria.description: Ids of the backing criteria in test-plan-review-criteria.json that evaluate this gate. Every id must resolve; an unresolvable id means a renamed criterion has orphaned its gate.

autoCheckable.description: Whether the deterministic rollup over review findings can resolve this gate without human confirmation.
